translations.translatedText: # Saturday 26.3.2022 (radio)
Finland's NATO membership. US President. Trains to Russia. Summer time. Winter storm. Weather forecast.
## Finland and NATO
![Sauli Niinistö.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5568,h_3132,x_0,y_237/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-933709623ecc7930529/1648283218)
Open image viewer
President Niinistö was on Yle's Ykkösaamu programme on Saturday. Photo: Tiina Jutila / Yle
In Finland there is discussion about whether Finland should apply to become a member of the military alliance NATO.

President Sauli Niinistö says that if Finland joins NATO, it will increase tension on Finland's border with Russia. Russia could then cause, for example, border violations and hybrid influencing in Finland.

President Niinistö spoke on Yle's Ykkösaamu programme on Saturday. Niinistö says that the most important effect of NATO membership is preventive. President Niinistö says that NATO is the sufficient security that Finland can get.
## The US president in Europe
![Joe Biden getting off an aircraft.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_7032,h_3955,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-933599623dcf77e58c2/1648218013)
Open image viewer
US President Joe Biden arrived in Poland on Friday. Photo: Darek Delmanowicz / EPA
US President Joe Biden met Ukraine's Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba and Ukraine's Defence Minister Oleksii Reznikov on Saturday. Biden met them in the Polish capital, Warsaw.
Ukrainian Foreign Minister Kuleba says that President Biden promised Ukraine more help. In Poland, Biden also met Ukrainian refugees and Polish President Andrzej Duda.
US President Joe Biden is visiting Europe because he wants to show US support for Europe. On Thursday, Biden was in Belgium, where he met the leaders of NATO and EU countries in Brussels.
## VR's freight traffic to Russia

![A train carrying a load of timber on the Suupohja line in Seinäjoki.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4608,h_2592,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-80678060a20d5696cdd/1621233166)
Open image viewer
VR is suspending train traffic to Russia. Photo: Elina Niemistö / Yle
The train company VR is suspending freight train traffic to Russia. The reason is the sanctions that Western countries have imposed on Russia.
Freight train traffic from Finland to Russia will end on Sunday.
VR said on Friday that passenger train traffic on the Allegro to St Petersburg will also end on Sunday.
## Summer time starts on Sunday
![A wall clock showing three o'clock.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3072,h_1727,x_0,y_149/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/17-5061856f1332c4d99e/1458647953)
Open image viewer
The time is moved forward one hour at 3 o'clock. Photo: Yle, Tero Kyllönen

Summer time starts on Sunday. The clocks are moved forward one hour early on Sunday morning. Summer time starts on Sunday night at 3 o'clock. Then the time is turned forward, that is, it becomes 4 o'clock summer time.
Summer time lasts until the end of October. At the end of October, the time is moved back one hour again.
Summer time starts and ends at the same time across the whole EU.
## Winter storm
![Storm in Espoo](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5112,h_2872,x_0,y_316/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-933789623f23cd4dc60/1648305126)
Open image viewer
A strong wind has torn off protective plastic at a construction site. Photo: Lehtikuva
There was a winter storm in Finland on Saturday. The wind has been strong.
In southern Finland it has snowed. Driving conditions have been poor.
The storm has caused many power cuts. On Saturday afternoon, power was cut off in about 35,000 homes.
## The weather
![Sunday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12377837)
Open image viewer
On Sunday it is sunny but cold.
The weather becomes dry and clear. On Sunday, it is mostly sunny across the whole of Finland. The temperature is between -2 and -7 degrees.
